title: Concept: CockroachDB error detail disclosed in a response
description: A CockroachDB error with its SQLSTATE code in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The code and message pair the engine with the failing object, which tells an injection attempt exactly which dialect and schema it is talking to.
applicability: Deployments that render a CockroachDB error with its SQLSTATE code into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The code and message pair the engine with the failing object, which tells an injection attempt exactly which dialect and schema it is talking to.
